text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端
purpose: Return the project to the actual calligraphy-tool mainline: make each Core Teacher attempt the complete scripture and expose only the missing capabilities that block production.

scopeLock.componentResearch: on-demand only when a concrete missing TC001 glyph requires it
scopeLock.whiteDayCafe: display resources only; tool remains offline until mature

pipeline: choose candidates by whole-sentence needs rather than isolated beauty
for missing glyphs, request only the minimum reconstruction evidence needed
flow adjustment from legitimate continuous-writing evidence

wang-xizhi.compositionIntent: natural emergence, contextual variation, implicit continuity before visible linking
blockers: six unresolved or insufficiently bound characters
need legitimate flow evidence beyond assembled inscription

mi-fu.compositionIntent: controlled imbalance and recovery, pressure/space contrast, non-uniform agitation
blockers: TC001 glyph coverage not yet run as a complete sentence

zhao-mengfu.compositionIntent: high readability with movement inside disciplined structure
blockers: TC001 glyph coverage not yet run as a complete sentence

wen-zhengming.compositionIntent: bone strength, cultivated long-line rhythm, controlled density and spacing
blockers: TC001 glyph coverage not yet run as a complete sentence

stopResearchRule: If a research question does not unblock one of the eleven TC001 characters, teacher-specific sentence flow, or the scripture-name readability gate, defer it.

nextGate.name: four-teacher-11-character-coverage
nextGate.requirement: Run the same eleven-character coverage pass for Mi Fu, Zhao Mengfu and Wen Zhengming, then compare all four teacher blockers in one table before doing any further deep research.
